description: Reynolds Kitchens Pop-Up Parchment Paper Sheets make roasting your favorite family meals simple with easy pop-up dispensing. Each precut nonstick parchment paper sheet lays flat with no curling and is sized to fit most standard baking pans. No need to trim or fold these grease proof baking paper sheets and the pop-up dispenser gives you easy, single-handed access. Oven safe up to 425 degrees Fahrenheit, this parchment paper for cooking and baking helps you create everyday meals quickly with minimal mess and easy cleanup.
